title: Jay McCobbs, the white theater owner who raised her mother
summary: McCobbs's household raised her mother, and she stayed in Pensacola when young rather than travel.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Jay McCobbs. My mother's mother died when she was born. She didn't know her mother. Well her grandmother was working for this year, Jay McCobbs. And she the one that was taking care of my mother when she was a little kid coming up. So they probably raised my mother. Yeah? They did.
Do you remember Thomas Mack that was with us, with that show, Mary Mack? Yeah.
Did you travel with them or?

No I didn't travel. I always stayed in Pensacola when I was quite young. My mother didn't mind me to go out of town, but you know. It's alright she didn't mind me playing right there in the city, but I was young at that time.
